keyVerseDR: "Was not our heart burning within us, whilst he spoke in the way and opened to us the scriptures?" (Lk 24:32)

level1.title: On the Road to Emmaus
level1.story: Two friends walked to Emmaus. Jesus walked with them, but they did not know Him. When He broke the bread, they knew it was Jesus!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How did they know it was Jesus?
Where do we see Jesus in bread?
level1.prayer: Jesus, walk with me always. Amen.

activity.title: The road to Emmaus
activity.intro: Trace the path of the two friends.

level2.title: The Road to Emmaus
level2.story: On Easter Sunday, two disciples were walking sadly to a village called Emmaus. Jesus came and walked with them, but they did not recognize Him. He explained what the Scriptures said about the Messiah, and their hearts burned within them. At supper, Jesus took bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to them. Then their eyes were opened, and they knew Him in the breaking of the bread.
level2.keyLine: Was not our heart burning within us?
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How is this story like the Mass?
When has your heart 'burned' for God?
actions: Listen closely to the readings at Mass
level2.prayer: Stay with me, Lord, and open my heart. Amen.

activity.title: Like Emmaus, like Mass
activity.intro: Jesus explained the Scriptures, then broke the bread. Number the parts of the Mass.
scenes: Liturgy of the Word: we hear the Scriptures
Liturgy of the Eucharist: bread is blessed and broken
Concluding Rites: we are sent out
